our_interpretation: This is a forecast against the near-term arrival of dependable conversational household robots, not a claim that useful demonstrations are impossible.
I interpret 'several years' as three to five years and use the fifth anniversary, 2027-08-18, as the latest deadline under that reading. Marcus did not specify this numerical range.

Reliable means repeatedly completing a range of ordinary household chores from spoken requests in ordinary homes, without frequent human rescue or remote control. It does not require perfection or every conceivable chore.
The surrounding discussion of a real-world product makes actual household availability relevant. A preorder or an isolated demonstration does not establish reliable arrival.
Reliability and household capability describe the forecast event; they are not separate conditional antecedents.
criteria.support_condition: After the interpreted deadline, a sufficiently broad record of product availability and household testing shows that no qualifying system materialized during the interval.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Before the interpreted deadline, a household robot becomes available for actual use and credible repeated testing establishes dependable performance on a range of everyday chores requested through speech.
